summary: Richmond Mutual Bancorporation filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its merger with The Farmers Bancorp, Frankfort, Indiana, effective July 1, 2026. Under the agreement dated November 11, 2025, each Farmers share was exchanged for 3.40 shares of Richmond common stock, resulting in Richmond issuing 6,254,357 shares. The merger was structured as a stock-for-stock transaction with cash for fractional shares. Richmond survived as the parent, and First Bank Richmond was renamed First Bank Midwest. The transaction received SEC effectiveness on April 3, 2026. No break fee or premium percentage was disclosed. Regulatory clocks have passed. Watch for post-merger integration updates and potential dilution impact on RMBI shares.
